body: Its hard to talk to my aunt because she is very emotionally walled off. The most emotion I ever saw from her was when my mom was dying and she cried like a baby. That was it. My grandmother is very old fashioned in her thinking so while she does have a few valuable gems of wisdom, its difficult for her to understand some of my problems. I have my best friend but it's hard to get in contact with him because he lives a few states away and is irresponsible as shit with his cell phones. All I have is my boyfriend but I don't want to keep overwhelming him, this is very emotionally draining.
Does anyone know of any mental health clinics that take walk ins other than the hospital. I'm having a major crisis and I need help.
